text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D at gains felt satisfying, but a gain versus my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each holding’s role and risk in the portfolio.","Recent price moves do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid chasing winners or assuming past performance will continue.","My recent purchases broadened my holdings, but I should keep diversification and available cash in mind and make each trade deliberately."]}
